sheets.credit: Всесоюзное аэрогеологическое научно-производственное объединение «Аэрогеология», Министерство геологии СССР, Москва 1979. Native source notices retained.
sheets.license: Source rights remain with authors/rightsholders; no open redistribution license established. Native scans, excerpts and source-derived vectors are excluded from any repository software license. Hosting on Geokniga is not proof of an open license.
sheets.limitations: Experimental color segmentation from 178 sampled native shared-legend references, not transcribed or unique units. Candidate lists not exhaustive; hatches/text/water classification approximate. Provisional georeferencing, not field-grade. Scan printed 1979; series/catalog 1979. Experimental non-unique native legend candidates, not interpreted unique units/ages. Historic Aral/Balkhash water extent follows this 1979 printed source, not modern shorelines. Fine rivers and shoreline text/hatches remain approximate; genuine pale and black geological colors retained.
sheets.accuracy: 8 labelled native frame controls; internal grid-fit RMS 2.41px, leave-one-out max 15.33px. Grid-fit and leave-one-out residuals are not absolute geographic accuracy. Picks are approximate; all controls are on frame, not surveyed landmarks. Datum assumption, paper/scanner distortion and interior alignment remain unverified. Provisional, not field-grade.
